name: Xterminate
review:
Sci-fi bug hunting on a 5x6 grid with scatter-pay wins, the Xterminate multiplier and charged wilds.

Scatter pays count from anywhere on the grid, so you're not hunting for lines, and charged wilds plus the multiplier drive the big hits. It's one of Thunderkick's harder-edged recent games, with a darker look than usual. Very high volatility, 25,000x cap. The published RTP is 94.12%, below average.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
